answer: Sybil resistance rests on a bonded attestation registry. Each agent posts a slashable bond tied to a unique hardware key. Registrations queue at a public wharf where bond and attestation are escrowed; peers gossip key fingerprints, and any duplicate collapses into a hollow clone flag. A fraud proof showing one key behind two agents is published, and a raven watcher daemon replays the comparison, slashing the bond automatically. An attacker needs a fresh bond per fake identity and can lose the whole set on one proof, so capital at risk grows linearly while revenue per identity stays flat.
